page.overview:
Who is Andrzej Sapkowski?

Andrzej Sapkowski wrote the Witcher short stories and novels that introduced Geralt, Ciri, Yennefer, and the politics of the Continent.

Also known as: Sapkowski, A. Sapkowski.
